purpose: Quick-to-detailed draft continuation and inline photo-reference pickers; synthetic UX concept
prompt:
Edit the supplied PrintFlow Studio QUICK-MODE concept screenshot into a NEW revised sibling image. Preserve its visual style, white/mint/teal palette, three columns, large readable Chinese typography, template cards, app branding, selected quick-mode tab, fictional demo name/dates and the fact this is a clearly labelled '交互设计稿 · 概念示意'. Do not modify the saved source file. Front-on desktop 16:10, not a poster.
The two essential changes must be unmistakable: (1) a clear '转到详细生成' action carries the current draft forward; (2) choose-photo actions are embedded DIRECTLY WHERE the prompt mentions person image 1 and layout image 2, and also visible as matching photo slots in the input column.
Keep top tabs '快速生成' selected and '详细生成' unselected. No numbered stepper. Main title '选模板、选照片，再继续完善提示词'. Small subtitle '可直接复制，也可带入详细生成继续修改'. Left template list remains '纪念 T恤' selected, '圆形纪念徽章', '只改姓名日期', with clear '编辑此模板' and '另存为新模板' actions.
Middle input panel title '填写本次信息'. Name 'DEMO A. PERSON', birth '12/06/1939', death '08/10/2026'; mark as fictional sample data. Replace the tiny reference chips with TWO generous dashed photo-selector cards stacked vertically. First labelled EXACT '人物照片 · 图1', contains a neutral photo icon and a clear button '选择人物照片', caption '未选择'. Second labelled EXACT '版式参考 · 图2', contains a neutral photo icon and a clear button '选择参考图片', caption '未选择'. Both are intentionally EMPTY; no actual photo is attached. A compact optional field '补充要求' says '保留胸前饰物，蓝白配色'. Bottom outlined '重新生成提示词'.
Right panel title '本次提示词 · 可直接编辑' with an amber '本次已编辑' tag. A large editable-text area. Its top two prompt lines must have clear INLINE TEAL BUTTON/PILL CONTROLS rather than static text:
Line 1: normal text '人物采用' followed immediately by a clickable-looking pill with photo-plus icon and EXACT text '图1 · 选择人物照片'.
Line 2: normal text '版式参考' followed immediately by a matching clickable-looking pill EXACT '图2 · 选择参考图片'.
These pills are inside the editor at their reference positions, not merely toolbar buttons. Make them large and readable. Remaining editor lines as plain editable text: '制作纪念 T恤独立图案。'; '姓名：DEMO A. PERSON'; 'SUNRISE 12/06/1939'; 'SUNSET 08/10/2026'; '保留面部、衣服、胸前饰物和原花框。'; '280 × 390 mm 构图，蓝白配色。'; '姓名文字使用象牙白。'; '图案外围透明，不绘制 T恤实物。'. Highlight only the ivory-text sentence subtly to indicate a manual edit. Beneath the editor a gentle amber message '还有 2 个照片引用待补充'. A neutral small note '选照片只更新引用，保留手写文字'.
At the bottom of the right panel show a prominent OUTLINED TEAL button EXACT '转到详细生成' with a right arrow. Beneath that button small helper EXACT '带入本次信息、照片和手改全文'. This transition button must be clearly visible, not only implied by the top mode tab.
Global fixed footer: a neutral left note '未选照片也可保存草稿，稍后补充'; right secondary '保存本次' and teal primary EXACT '复制草稿'. Using '草稿' is essential because the two photo roles are empty. Do not show upload success, automatically selected customer images, image-generation success or mandatory six-step approval. Keep both new features visible and avoid dense small text.
